Subject: Azure private offer - renewal sequencing & capacity swap

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep momentum for the renewal and the proposed capacity increase, here's what we need to align on from Redwood's side:

- Acceptance window for the Private Offer (AWS): we can accept on your behalf once we receive a PO and the signed SOW. The marketplace acceptance step must occur within a 30-day window after PO receipt.
- Capacity swap: you mentioned moving 30% of committed capacity from eu-west-1 to us-west-2 effective 2027-05-01. We need confirmation of effective date and whether billing should be prorated at the time of region swap.
- Staggered billing: Stellar asked for a split invoice across two tranches (50/50). We can mirror that on our billing if AWS private offer and PO align.

I'm attaching an updated SOW (Stellar_SOW_v2.pdf) with the revised region mapping and acceptance language. Ben and Soojin are looped in for procurement and marketplace ops.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Procurement sends PO referencing SD-4782 and the attached SOW.
2) Redwood confirms final PO details and uploads to AWS private offer flow.
3) Stellar confirms billing tranches and effective swap date so we can schedule the transfer and prorate accordingly.

If this matches your plan I'll coordinate the docs and a short call with AWS Marketplace ops to ensure the private-offer acceptance timing is correct.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes

Emma / Rafael —

Thanks. Quick operational plan from Redwood ops/procurement to make this low friction:

1) PO checklist (what procurement should include):
   - PO number, billing contact, tax info, and explicit reference to SOW version (Stellar_SOW_v2.pdf).
   - Line item showing total committed units and the requested 30% regional reallocation effective 2027-05-01.
   - Billing tranche instruction (50% billed at term start, 50% billed 6 months later) and billing emails.

2) Marketplace acceptance flow: once PO + signed SOW are received, Redwood will create the AWS Private Offer acceptance package and upload the acceptance artifact (we'll send you the AWS_PrivateOffer_2104.pdf as confirmation). AWS usually takes 48-72 hours to process the acceptance.

3) Proration / swap: Redwood will apply proration for the capacity moved on 2027-05-01. We'll provide an interim invoice adjustment line item, not a retro bill, so your procurement team can reconcile easily.

4) Rollback plan: if acceptance is delayed beyond AWS's acceptance window, we keep current capacity until acceptance completes; no changes will be applied retroactively.

I'll stand by to review the PO when you have it. If helpful, Rafael and I can join a 20-min sync with your procurement to walk through the exact PO language.

-Ben

Hi —

Thanks for the PO draft. Confirming next steps and providing the short-form language procurement requested.

1) Non-retroactivity confirmation (short form to include in your records):
"Redwood Inference confirms that changes to regional capacity allocations executed at the start of the renewed term (effective 2027-05-01) will be applied prospectively; Redwood will not issue retroactive charges for capacity moved within the first 30 days of the new term. Any prorated adjustments will appear as a one-time invoice line on the initial billing statement."

2) Acceptance timing: once we receive PO_SD-4782 (final signed) + signed SOW, Redwood will upload the private-offer acceptance. We will provide the private-offer confirmation file (AWS_PrivateOffer_2104.pdf) and the approximate AWS processing timestamp. AWS processing typically completes within 72 hours, but we'll notify you immediately when the acceptance artifact is uploaded.

3) Invoice schedule: confirmed — 50% on 2027-05-01, 50% six months later. We will send a proforma invoice for Stellar's finance team to reconcile after AWS completes acceptance.

DocuSign route: If you prefer DocuSign, here's the acceptance room we've prepared: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/SD-4782-accept. Otherwise, email the signed PO to procurement@redwood.com and we'll proceed.
